blocks.text: Heat waves, wildfires and floods endanger the health, food supplies and livelihoods of people around the globe. As the consequences of climate change are becoming increasingly tangible, false or misleading information is being spread more aggressively, particularly via social media. The deliberate dissemination of such information is referred to as climate disinformation. In recent years, DW Akademie has supported targeted efforts to combat climate disinformation around the world, including through projects in Colombia, the Philippines, Namibia and throughout the Middle East and North Africa. What is climate disinformation? Today, climate disinformation rarely takes the form of outright denial. Rather than fundamentally disputing climate change, its consequences are […]...
